note: Regional park on the west side of Wilkie at Highway 29 and 8th Street West, across from the community complex: a treed loop of sites at the back of a park of four ball diamonds, with a camp kitchen and playground, and the town's outdoor pool within walking distance. ATVs are not permitted in the park. --Claude
summary: Keep (local). Confirmed 22 sites (12 x 30 A, 5 x 15 A, 5 non-electric; campground map), 30 A, showers, dump, season 05-15..09-30, phone booking; fees written C$20-30 + C$5/vehicle/day entry (2026 town rate schedule). PIN MOVE ~320 m to the campground loop 52.4099,-108.7179. Google 4.9 (8). Nightly share unmeasured (no seasonal rate, monthly offered). Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: PIN MOVE (~320 m): stored 52.41200,-108.71470 sits on the park's entrance road at the NE corner by ball diamond #2 (the SRP GPS 52.41270,-108.71470 is the entrance too). The town's campground map puts the site loop (with the picnic hut and the shower house inside it) in the SW corner of the park, below ball diamond #4; on Esri imagery that loop, picnic hut and washroom building are at ~52.4099,-108.7179. Move the pin there.

LONG-STAY (local): nightly share not measurable - no booking engine and no site-by-site seasonal list. The SRP amenity list ticks 'Camping Seasonal' but no seasonal rate is posted anywhere; weekly and monthly electrical rates are ($700/month in the 2026 town schedule, $650 on the SRP page). Nothing discourages nightly guests: the town says 'To reserve a campsite please call', and the 2026 rate schedule leads with daily rates. Google Maps 'Wilkie Regional Park' 4.9 (8 reviews). Not read as mostly seasonal.

BOOKING CONFLICT: the SRPA 2026 guide says 'Reservations: Accepted only when entire campground is reserved and prepaid', but the SRP park page and the town page both take ordinary site reservations by phone/email. Page wording used. fcfs not stated (after-hours payment drop box suggests walk-ins are taken).

FEES: monthly electrical $700 in the town's 2026 rate schedule (created 2026-05-06) vs $650 on the SRP page; the 2026 schedule used. Park rental rates differ too ($200/$300 vs $165/$275). Taxes not stated. Non-electrical sites ($20) are ordinary loop sites on the map, not a tent area.

PHONE: 306-210-9290 kept (SRP page reservations line; town page). The SRPA 2026 guide prints '306-210-9280 or 306-843-2690' - looks like typos of 9290 / 2692. Google's number 306-843-2692 is the Town of Wilkie office (the tourism page: 'contact the Town of Wilkie at (306)843-2692'). The town tourism page's '27 camping units' is outdated vs 22 on the SRP page and map.
HOOKUPS: water/sewer at sites not stated (potable water 'at several locations throughout the park') - left unset.
WEBSITE: stored SRP page live; consider adding the town page https://townofwilkie.com/community/recreation.html (links the 2026 rates and campground map).
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed (in town, no water nearby).
OWNERSHIP: local confirmed - Wilkie Regional Park Authority, formed by the Town of Wilkie in 1970 on town land (SRP page).
